prompt: A rectangular garden measures 18 m by 24 m. A path 1.5 m wide runs around the inside edge of the garden. What is the area of the remaining inner rectangle, in square metres?
trap_note: The path is subtracted from BOTH sides of each dimension. Subtracting 1.5 once per dimension gives 16.5 x 22.5 = 371.25, which is arithmetically clean and wrong -- the wrong chain looks fully worked.
source: authored for this bank, M1-4 (2026-09-11). RETIRED from the bank by ADR-005 (accepted 11 Sep 2026): reproduced 0/5 in both regimes, so the is_trap claim was withdrawn. Kept here as the measured record; the bank item of the same id is now a plain item.
